data.one_liner: Provides root, jailbreak, debugger, screenshot, VPN and other security checks for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Offers a set of native‑level detections (root/jailbreak, hooking, debugger, screen capture, overlay attacks, VPN, app‑store source, etc.) as Futures or Streams. The API is modular, letting you compose the signals into your own UI without bundled widgets.
use_when: You need to detect device compromise or tampering on Android/iOS
You want a zero‑dependency security toolkit that returns raw data/streams
You require tiered risk levels for root or emulator detection
avoid_when: You need cross‑platform UI components for security (e.g., secure text fields)
Your app runs only on web or desktop where these checks aren’t applicable
strengths: Tiered risk model for flexible policy
Provides both simple booleans and detailed results
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS platforms
Requires native permissions and Gradle/Pod configuration
No built‑in UI widgets, you must implement your own
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin, request Android permissions (e.g., READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE for root checks) and iOS entitlements if needed; no build_runner required.

alternatives.name: device_info_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides basic device information without the extensive security checks, useful if you only need generic info

alternatives.name: permission_handler
alternatives.why_pick_it: Manages runtime permissions needed by security checks, can be used alongside or instead of this package for permission handling
